items.l1-u01-d1: Are you at the school door?

items.l1-u06-d5: Yes, and the water is here.

items.l1-u07-d3: Can you come to the park first?

items.l1-u08-d7: Do you want to walk there now?
items.l2-u01-d1: Please put these cups on the table.

items.l2-u01-d5: Yes, and its color is pink.

items.l2-u03-d3: Can you see the fox, too?
items.l2-u03-d7: Do you want to draw this zoo?
items.l2-u04-d1: Do you want cake or candy?
items.l2-u04-d5: What does Dad want to eat?
items.l2-u05-d1: Please close your book. Lunch is ready.
items.l2-u05-d7: Yes, and give me your bowl first.
items.l2-u06-d3: Do you want the green shirt?
items.l2-u06-d5: How about this cute pink one?
items.l2-u06-d7: The gray one looks friendly and clean.
items.l2-u07-d1: Hi! Can I sit here for the picnic?
items.l2-u07-d3: Oh, I can sit by the yellow bag.
items.l2-u07-d5: Wow, it looks nice on you.
items.l2-u07-d7: Do you want to sing our song?
items.l3-u01-d1: When can we study our English words together?
items.l3-u01-d3: I have school then. Is the afternoon OK?
items.l3-u01-d5: At my house, with my sister.
items.l3-u01-d7: Why do you need these word cards?
items.l3-u02-d1: When does our family breakfast start tomorrow?
items.l3-u02-d3: Will Aunt Anna and Uncle Ben come?
items.l3-u02-d5: Can I invite my friend Sam too?
items.l3-u02-d7: Great, I will call him before two p.m.
items.l3-u03-d1: Why is that duck under the tree?
items.l3-u03-d3: Can we give the animal some water?
items.l3-u03-d5: My hand is dirty from the chalk.
items.l3-u03-d7: After that, can we fly my kite?
items.l3-u04-d1: What did you eat for breakfast today?
items.l3-u04-d3: Did you make the cookies at school?
items.l3-u04-d5: Did you write how to make them?
items.l3-u04-d7: Did your teacher give you an eraser?
items.l3-u05-d1: Why are you wearing that coat and hat?
items.l3-u05-d3: Are you wearing your new red dress?
items.l3-u05-d7: Good, I will call her on my phone.
items.l3-u06-d1: Are we taking the train for our trip?
items.l3-u06-d3: Can we take our bikes with us?
items.l3-u06-d5: Should I call him and ask now?
items.l3-u06-d7: Look, a red kite can fly very high.
items.l3-u07-d1: Do you want to join our ball game?
items.l3-u07-d3: Try again, and kick the ball slowly.
items.l3-u07-d5: Your coat is still wet from the rain.
items.l3-u07-d7: Good. We can make two teams together.
items.l3-u08-d1: Do you have any money with you?
items.l3-u08-d3: Really? Your bag is down there.
items.l3-u08-d5: Good, but our bus is here now.
items.l3-u08-d7: Okay, I have it. Good-bye, Amy.
items.l4-u01-d1: Does this paper show the right date?
items.l4-u01-d3: Which day is the sports day?
items.l4-u01-d5: Can you speak to the teacher about this?
items.l4-u01-d7: Good, because some students want to know.
items.l4-u02-d1: How old is your grandmother now?

items.l4-u02-d5: I never stop there. I stop at thirty.
items.l4-u02-d7: Good. Can you come to my house soon?
items.l4-u03-d3: Will you see your grandparents this weekend?
items.l4-u03-d7: That is nice. Are you thirsty now?
items.l4-u04-d1: Did you do your homework for reading class?
items.l4-u04-d3: Can I use your crayon for my drawing?
items.l4-u04-d5: I want to paint a snake on this page.
items.l4-u04-d7: Good idea. Do you want some bread?

items.l4-u05-d7: Can we have a sweet snack after dinner?

items.l4-u06-d7: Then let us eat there after we see him.

items.l4-u07-d3: It is better after some minutes.
items.l4-u07-d5: Can you buy some bread on that street?
items.l4-u07-d7: Do not worry, the shop is very near.
items.l4-u08-d1: The weather is warm and sunny today.
items.l4-u08-d3: Your new dress is very pretty.
items.l4-u08-d5: Is she the tall one with long hair?
items.l4-u08-d7: Are you sure she is only twelve?

items.l4-u09-d5: Did you see the news about the winter?
items.l4-u09-d7: It said there will be snow this season.

items.l4-u10-d5: That red paper in front of the door is pretty.
